**Migration boundary:** the pinned script describes the former Demerzel-to-Learn import. Current Learn pages use Learn `main` source/edit links, and the initial copy plus supplemental manifests have different origins. A mutable `main` URL alone does not identify the deployed lesson revision. The old script has not been adapted or run as a validator of this Learn candidate. For current readback, bind the deployed Learn commit, the reviewed source blob, its supplemental origin when applicable, and the rendered lesson content. A failure of the old link pattern alone does not prove a current page is wrong.
